_meta.title: UNET
_meta.note: krea2-Turbo GGUF primary model. Matches image_krea2.json node 1.

_meta.title: CLIP
_meta.note: Qwen3-VL-4B fp8_scaled text encoder for krea2.

_meta.title: PLATE_IMG
_meta.note: Scene location master plate (no people). Uploaded by stage3b via comfy.upload_image(); the registered filename is patched here. Every shot in the scene starts from this same plate, giving consistent background/location across the story.

_meta.title: PLATE_ENCODE
_meta.note: Encodes the plate to krea2 latent space via qwen_image_vae; becomes the KSampler's starting latent. Resolution is inherited from the plate (1024x576), so no EmptySD3LatentImage is needed.

_meta.title: PROMPT_POS
_meta.note: The assembled sd_prompt (character description + composition/environment tokens) lands here; composited onto the plate's backdrop. Same anchors as stage1r's character reference sheets so identities stay consistent.

_meta.title: NEG_ZEROOUT
_meta.note: krea2-Turbo is CFG-distilled (cfg=1.0); negative is a zero-out of the positive, mirroring image_krea2.json node 12.

_meta.title: IDENTITY_REF
_meta.note: Character identity reference image (from stage1r front reference sheet). Uploaded by stage3b. Used with IPAdapter for identity lock. Optional - bypass by setting IDENTITY_STRENGTH=0.0.

_meta.title: IP_ADAPTER_IDENTITY
_meta.note: IPAdapter for krea2 identity reference. Uses the krea2-compatible IPAdapter model (IPAdapter-Plus or similar for Qwen-Image latent space). Model file patched via IDENTITY_IPADAPTER_MODEL.

_meta.title: IP_ADAPTER_APPLY_IDENTITY
_meta.note: Applies identity IPAdapter to positive conditioning. Strength patched via IDENTITY_STRENGTH (0.0 to bypass, 0.5-0.8 typical). Noise strength 0.0 for pure identity.

_meta.title: STYLE_REF
_meta.note: Style reference image (from stage1r style reference sheet). Uploaded by stage3b. Used with IPAdapter for style lock. Optional - bypass by setting STYLE_STRENGTH=0.0.

_meta.title: IP_ADAPTER_STYLE
_meta.note: IPAdapter for krea2 style reference. Uses the krea2-compatible IPAdapter model. Model file patched via STYLE_IPADAPTER_MODEL.

_meta.title: IP_ADAPTER_APPLY_STYLE
_meta.note: Applies style IPAdapter to positive conditioning. Strength patched via STYLE_STRENGTH (0.0 to bypass, 0.3-0.5 typical).

_meta.title: SAMPLER
_meta.note: krea2 IMG2IMG recipe with identity/style refs: euler/simple, 8 steps, cfg 1.0. DENOISE < 1.0 blends the plate's locked background with the character prompt + identity/style refs. Default 0.35 (tighter plate lock for background consistency). SEED patched per shot. SAMPLER + SCHEDULER + STEPS + CFG + IDENTITY_STRENGTH + STYLE_STRENGTH are exposed as patchable knobs.

_meta.title: DECODE
_meta.note: Decodes the redrawn latent back to RGB via qwen_image_vae.

_meta.title: REFINE_SHARPEN
_meta.note: Stock ComfyUI post-decode detail refinement. Light, GPU-cheap. Knobs SHARPEN_RADIUS / SHARPEN_SIGMA / SHARPEN_ALPHA are patchable from stack.toml [animation]; set alpha 0.0 to bypass.

_meta.title: SAVE
_meta.note: Writes the panel PNG under ComfyUI/output/<SAVE_PREFIX>; ComfyClient copies it into the project panels dir.
